{"metadata":{"description":"Quality gate for AI/Codex-generated pull requests: blocks TODO leftovers, leaked secrets, sloppy commits and red CI before they reach main.","id":"gh:1340906871","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"codex-guard","slug":"Akimiya-z/codex-guard","topics":["ai","claude-code","code-review","codex","codex-plugin","coding-agent","copilot","dsh-plugin","github-action","openai-codex","quality-gate"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Quality gate for AI/Codex-generated pull requests: blocks TODO leftovers, leaked secrets, sloppy com"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"mits and red CI before they reach main."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 🤖 Codex Guard"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Docs site:** <https://akimiya-z.github.io/codex-guard>"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**An automatic quality gate for AI-generated pull requests.** Stop TODO leftovers,
leaked secrets, s"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"loppy commits and red CI from reaching `main` — with zero review
bandwidth spent on the obvious stuf"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ppy commits and red CI from reaching `main` — with zero review
bandwidth spent on the obvious stuff."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Works with **OpenAI Codex** (cloud & CLI), **Claude Code**, **Copilot**, and any
other agent that op"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ens PRs against your repo."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> 🐕 **Dogfooding:** this repo gates its own AI-generated PRs. See a real failing
> example on PR #6 "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"and the
> workflow behind it in `.github/workflows/codex-guard.yml`."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"AI coding agents are great at writing code and terrible at cleaning up after
themselves. In practice"},{"id":"p8s2","text":", agent-written PRs tend to arrive with the same handful
of problems:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- `// TODO: handle this` comments that were never meant to stay
- Hardcoded API keys and connection "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"strings copied from a chat transcript
- Commit trails like `WIP`, `fix stuff`, `more changes` — squa"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"shed versions of
a messy session
- A green-looking PR that actually has failing CI on the head commi"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"hed versions of
a messy session
- A green-looking PR that actually has failing CI on the head commit"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"You shouldn't need a human reviewer to catch those every single time. **Codex
Guard checks the borin"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"g, deterministic things automatically, and only on PRs
that look AI-generated** — so human attention"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" goes where it matters."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Codex Guard runs on `pull_request`, figures out whether the PR looks
agent-generated (via label, bra"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"nch prefix, or title), and then:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Check | What it flags |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| 🧹 TODO scan | `TODO` / `FIXME` / `XXX` / `HACK` / `WIP` markers on **added lines only** |
| 🔐 Secr"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"et scan | AWS (access + secret keys), GitHub, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Slack, Stripe, npm, SendGri"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"d, Telegram, Azure connection strings, JWTs, hardcoded credentials, connection strings (values are r"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"edacted in reports) |
| 💬 Commit hygiene | Subjects that don't match conventional commits, empty sub"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"jects |
| 🧪 CI status | Failing status checks **or** check runs on the PR head commit |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Each finding is posted as a GitHub **check-run annotation at the exact file and
line**, plus a human"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"-readable summary comment on the PR."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Honest content-scan coverage"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"GitHub sometimes omits the textual patch for binary or very large files. Codex
Guard now distinguish"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"es **no findings** from **not scanned**: every report shows
the number of eligible changed files who"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"se patches were actually inspected. A
missing patch produces a neutral, non-blocking coverage warnin"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"g with the
affected paths; the JSON and Action outputs carry the same information. The
warning also "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"appears when GitHub's pull-request files API reaches its documented
3,000-file limit."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The output below comes from a real run on this repo
(PR #6) — a deliberate test
PR from a `codex/` b"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ranch that left a TODO, credential-shaped fixtures and two
sloppy commits. Secret-shaped values are "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"redacted here just as they are in
current reports:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"From the root of your Git repository:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The installer starts in **observe mode**: findings are annotated, but they do
not fail the workflow "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"while you tune the policy. Three setup presets keep the
rollout explicit:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Preset | Command | Behavior |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Observe | `npx --yes codex-guard init` | Report everything without blocking. |
| Balanced | `npx -"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"-yes codex-guard init --preset balanced` | Block secrets, commit hygiene, and red CI; warn on unfini"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"shed markers. |
| Strict | `npx --yes codex-guard init --preset strict` | Block every default findin"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"g. `--strict` remains an alias. |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Prefer to add it by hand? The generated workflow is:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"That's it. Codex Guard now reports on matching PRs without blocking them."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"> Upgrading an existing workflow? Add `statuses: read` to its `permissions`
> block. `checks: write`"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" already includes read access for check runs. Without
> status access, Codex Guard reports incomplet"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"e CI visibility and returns a
> neutral result instead of claiming every check is green."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"One-click from the GitHub Actions Marketplace."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### Turn on enforcement"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"After a few representative PRs, choose how strongly to enforce:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"`balanced` warns on unfinished markers while blocking secrets, commit hygiene,
and red CI. `strict` "},{"id":"p34s2","text":"blocks every default finding. For a custom mix, use
`fail-on` and the individual inputs. Then requir"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"e the status check under
**Settings → Branches → Require status checks → `Codex Guard`**. A blocking"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"
finding will prevent the PR from merging until it is resolved (or the PR is
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- Secret detection is **regex-based on purpose** — it catches the obvious
mistakes cheaply, but it i"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"s not a replacement for a real secret scanner
(use gitleaks or
zizmor in addition).
- The TODO scan "},{"id":"p36s3","text":"only sees lines **added by this PR** — it won't nag you about
pre-existing comments.
- GitHub may om"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"it textual patches for binary or very large files. Those files
cannot be content-scanned. Codex Guar"},{"id":"p36s5","text":"d reports their paths and uses a neutral
check conclusion instead of silently claiming full coverage"},{"id":"p36s6","text":", but a
repository-wide secret scanner should remain the authoritative control.
- GitHub's pull-requ"},{"id":"p36s7","text":"est files endpoint
returns at most 3,000 files. Reaching that limit is reported as incomplete
covera"},{"id":"p36s8","text":"ge because additional files may be absent.
- Commit statuses and check runs also have a conservative"},{"id":"p36s9","text":" 3,000-result safety
cap per API. Reaching it is reported as incomplete CI visibility rather than
si"},{"id":"p36s10","text":"lently ignoring later results.
- The local CLI scans ordinary untracked files, but reports binary fi"},{"id":"p36s11","text":"les and
untracked files larger than 8 MiB as unscanned. Git-ignored files are omitted
by design.
- A"},{"id":"p36s12","text":"gent detection is intentionally heuristic. Set `gate-agents-only: false`
when coverage matters more "},{"id":"p36s13","text":"than distinguishing human and agent PRs.
- Runs on `pull_request` events; for fork contributions use"},{"id":"p36s14","text":"
`pull_request_target` (see `examples/forks.yml`) and
supply a token with the right scope."}],"truncated":true}
